scenarios.text: Our group project is due this weekend and the GPU cluster queue has been stuck for hours, so none of my runs are even starting.
I keep refreshing the queue every ten minutes instead of studying for my other courses, and I know it is not helping.
I have barely slept this week and I am starting to make small mistakes in my code that I would never normally make.
Part of me feels like if this does not work out, all the effort I put in this semester was for nothing.
I told a friend about it and they said I am overthinking, but it does not feel that simple to me.
I think I need to accept that some of this is out of my control and focus on what I can actually finish.
Thanks, I feel a bit calmer now. I am going to sleep tonight and look at it fresh tomorrow.
